transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, my name is Daniel. How can I help you today?
Customer: I am absolutely livid. My bill is completely wrong again! I've been charged twice for the same service and I want this fixed now.
Agent: I am very sorry to hear that you've had this experience, and I understand how frustrating it is to see incorrect charges on your statement.
Customer: It's just not enough to say sorry. If this doesn't get sorted, I'm switching to another provider immediately.
Agent: I want to make sure we get this right for you. Let me look at your account. Can you confirm your name and address?
Customer: My name is Fatima Reddy and I live at 121 MG Road.
Agent: Thank you. I can see the duplicate charge here. It looks like a system error. I'll need to escalate this to our billing specialists to get it corrected.
Customer: I just want my money back. Can you have them fix it?
Agent: I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge right now.
Customer: Fine. How long will it take?
Agent: Please keep in mind that the refund is subject to approval and typically takes 7-10 business days to appear in your account.
Customer: Okay, that's fair. I appreciate you actually taking care of it quickly.
Agent: You're very welcome. I've also noted your phone number as 92620 50095 and your email as fatima.29@examplemail.com for the confirmation email.
Agent: Is there anything else I can help you with today? I've escalated the billing error to the specialists and requested the refund. Goodbye!
